description: Verify seed topics have been materialized from topic_registry to seed_topics/ directory: directory non-empty, each file has non-empty title, slug set is bidirectionally consistent with registry, and trace evidence is present. Source-gate status-window and handoff witness are enforced by shared gate preflight.

rules.failure_message: seed_topics/ directory is empty. Materialize each topic from topic_registry into seed_topics/<slug>.md files.
Slug consistency check failed. The set of slugs in seed_topics/*.md must be exactly equal to the set of slugs in rb_plan.md topic_registry — no missing, no extra.
A seed topic file has an empty or missing 'title' field in its frontmatter.
A seed topic file's frontmatter 'slug' does not match its filename stem. They must be byte-for-byte equal.

A current Seed Topic has an invalid initialization boundary, a renderer-owned ghost below it, or a template pending placeholder line still inside its initialization region. Edit only the declared initialization region: replace every placeholder with authored content or an explicitly rephrased gap stating the specific missing fact, and preserve the Engine-owned appendix.
